definition: A named set of block identifiers, expandable by regex pattern, by explicit list, or by reference to other tags.
Baked acoustic properties (impedance, permeation, state) derived from blended raw physical properties.
A skeletal RawMaterial generated per block whose solutes are that block's tags; carries no physical properties of its own.
Recursive resolution of references (tag->tag, material->solute) into concrete values.
Final conversion of resolved raw physical properties into a runtime Material.
